purpose: Research-only inventory of published North/Central/South Biscayne Bay landmark references. No cross-bay boundary geometry is created.

literature_basis.title: Characterizing Nearshore Fish Assemblages From Intact and Altered Mangrove Shorelines in Biscayne Bay, Florida, United States
literature_basis.limitation: Published landmark extents do not provide digitized cross-bay separator lines. These labels do not authorize drawing cross-bay polygons.

landmarks.name: Dumfoundling Bay

candidate_reference.coordinate_source: GNIS Feature ID 281852 as reported by a secondary GNIS-derived feature page

notes: The coordinate is a named-feature reference point, not a shoreline or cross-bay boundary.
Verify directly against the current USGS GNIS download/API before promotion.

landmarks.name: Rickenbacker Causeway
notes: County describes a 3.6-mile corridor with distinct bridge and roadway segments.
Bear Cut Bridge is the eastern bridge between Virginia Key and Key Biscayne; the causeway is not one single bridge line.
Use the actual causeway corridor/land polygons to assess a cross-bay separator, not just one bridge segment.

landmarks.name: Featherbed Bank

candidate_reference.source_layer: NOAA ENC Harbour Sea Area Named Water Area, layer 237

notes: NOAA classifies the feature as a bank.
The source polygon is a named chart context, not a cross-bay boundary or a current habitat survey.

landmarks.name: Black Point
landmarks.role: Alternative/paired Central/South Biscayne Bay separator landmark

candidate_reference.source_description: Miami-Dade County Black Point Marina page gives the outer channel marker at 25 degrees 31.5 minutes N, 80 degrees 17.9 minutes W.

notes: This is an approach marker offshore of Black Point Marina, not the Black Point shoreline or a separator line.
Keep Black Point and Featherbed Bank as distinct references until the literature's paired landmark meaning is spatially resolved.

landmarks.name: Card Sound
notes: Six chart-cell polygons form a multi-cell named-water source set.
The six features must be retrieved and mosaicked/reviewed with their original chart-cell identity preserved.
Do not infer that Card Sound's named-water polygon edge is the ecological southern boundary.

landmarks.name: Jewfish Creek
landmarks.role: Paired South Biscayne Bay southern landmark
notes: The NOAA station is explicitly named Jewfish Creek, Barnes Sound.
A tidal benchmark location is not the creek mouth, channel centerline, or ecological boundary.
NOAA Coast Pilot distinguishes Card Sound, Little Card Sound, Barnes Sound, and Jewfish Creek as separate waterway reaches.

next_actions: Retrieve the current official USGS GNIS record for Dumfoundling Bay and preserve its source metadata.
Extract the full Rickenbacker Causeway corridor from county roadway/bridge and land-area geometry; identify the water-crossing separator only where the source geometry supports it.
Retrieve all six NOAA Card Sound polygons by exact OBJECTID and preserve chart-cell provenance.
Retrieve NOAA chart/hydrographic geometry for Jewfish Creek and distinguish the channel from the NOAA tidal benchmark station.
Assess whether Featherbed Bank and Black Point represent one paired regional separator or two alternative landmarks; do not collapse them into one coordinate.
Only then test feature membership against the candidate separators. Keep subregion polygon geometry null until a defensible cross-bay line exists.
guardrails: No boundary line is generated from point coordinates or bounding boxes.
No ecological region is equated with an FDEP preserve boundary.
No channel connectivity or fish passage is inferred from proximity.
